evals.name: strider-fb-only
evals.prompt: /marketplace:listing on examples/garage/inventory.csv (single Strider 12 Sport balance bike row), FB Marketplace only (default platform), --location="Phoenix, AZ 85016".
evals.expected_output: A {ItemPrefix}-Listing.md with Item Details, live eBay pricing analysis + recommendation, one Facebook Marketplace listing block, and a recommended photo order. Quality should match or beat examples/garage/Strider-12-Sport-generated.md. The seat puncture must appear as a known-issue and be disclosed in a photo slot.
assertions: No eBay listing block is present (FB-only run respected the default platform)
The seat puncture appears as a known-issue in the FB listing body
The seat puncture is given a dedicated photo slot in the recommended photo order
No unresolved placeholder tokens survive in the output
Final list price and a lower drop price are both present and plausible vs the live eBay used range
Pricing analysis cites a live research date in 'Month D, YYYY' format

evals.name: strider-fb-ebay
evals.prompt: /marketplace:listing "Strider 12 Sport Balance Bike ST-S4RD", Used (Good), --platforms=fb,ebay --location="Phoenix, AZ 85016".
evals.expected_output: A listing file with BOTH a Facebook Marketplace block and an eBay block. eBay title <=80 chars, Item Specifics table, eBay condition mapped to a valid enum value. The {RETAIL_CALLOUT}/{INCLUDES_SECTION} machinery should render identically in spirit across both platform blocks (same retail anchor, same inclusions). No leftover placeholder tokens.
assertions: Both a Facebook Marketplace block and an eBay block are present
eBay condition is one of the valid eBay enum/dropdown values
The retail callout (MSRP anchor) is consistent between the FB and eBay blocks
The Includes section content is consistent between the FB and eBay blocks
No unresolved placeholder tokens survive in either block
Pricing analysis cites a live research date in 'Month D, YYYY' format

evals.name: uppababy-includes-filter
evals.prompt: /marketplace:listing "UPPAbaby Vista stroller", Used (Good), notes: comes with bassinet, rain shield, and original box. --platforms=fb,ebay --location="Phoenix, AZ 85016". No photos available.
evals.expected_output: A listing with an Includes section that KEEPS genuine extras (bassinet, rain shield, original box) and FILTERS OUT integral parts (canopy, basket, harness, wheels) even if they get mentioned. Retail callout anchored to UPPAbaby MSRP. Graceful handling of the no-photos case (notes thin/absent photos rather than fabricating a photo order).
assertions: Includes section KEEPS the genuine extras: bassinet, rain shield, and original box
Includes section EXCLUDES integral stroller parts (canopy, basket, harness, wheels, frame)
Retail callout is anchored to a real UPPAbaby Vista MSRP, not a fabricated number
No-photos case is handled gracefully (no fabricated photo order; absence noted)
No unresolved placeholder tokens survive in either block
Both FB and eBay blocks are present
